extractions.description: The paper discusses a method for evaluating generative models using synthetic datasets. It introduces a scalable evaluation method tailored to categorical data, applied to high-dimensional distribution spaces. The aim is to better understand generative models' strengths, weaknesses, and performance, particularly in out-of-distribution (OOD) capability and sample generation quality. This is achieved by binning the probability space and using statistical identity testing.
